diagnosis.title: API Token Quota Reached (LCM_818)
diagnosis.meaning: The active Sensorise API token has reached its 100 API calls transactions quota.
diagnosis.root_cause: Each Sensorise SenseLCM token is granted a 100 transactions quota. Once exhausted, a fresh token is required.
diagnosis.common_reasons: Sensorise API tokens automatically expire after 24 hours or after transaction quotas are exhausted.
diagnosis.action_items:
• A fresh API token is automatically generated via /generateAPIToken.
• All subsequent requests automatically use the newly generated token.
